$extensions.source: raycast.com + ray.so themes + Raycast API docs + cmdk/raycast example + Behance branding case study
$extensions.aesthetic: macOS-native dark launcher — glass panels, vibrant gradient accents, keyboard-first command palette

surface.$description: Launcher Background — warm dark gray with slight blue undertone, matches macOS dark mode chrome

surface-raised.$description: Raised panel — sidebar, search input area, one step above launcher bg

surface-elevated.$description: Elevated surface — command list items on hover, dropdown menus, extension cards

surface-overlay.$description: Overlay surface — tooltips, context menus, action bar background

surface-glass.$description: Glass panel — translucent bg for frosted glass panels, requires backdrop-filter: blur(40px)

accent.$description: Raycast Red — primary brand accent, default theme loader and icon tint color

accent-hover.$description: Accent hover — lighter red for interactive feedback

accent-gradient-start.$description: Gradient start — the red anchor of Raycast's signature red-to-pink gradient

accent-gradient-end.$description: Gradient end — vibrant pink, the warm endpoint of the brand gradient

accent-subtle.$description: Accent wash — selected list item background, active command tint

text-primary.$description: Primary text — near-white with warmth, never pure #ffffff to reduce glare on dark

text-secondary.$description: Secondary text — command descriptions, metadata, subtitle in list items

text-tertiary.$description: Tertiary text — keyboard shortcut hints, disabled labels, placeholder text

text-on-accent.$description: White on accent — button labels on gradient or solid accent backgrounds

error.$description: Error red — matches Raycast theme red semantic color, validation and destructive actions

error-subtle.$description: Error background tint — error toast background, validation highlights

success.$description: Success green — matches Raycast theme green, confirmation toasts and status indicators

success-subtle.$description: Success background tint — success toast backgrounds

warning.$description: Warning orange — matches Raycast theme orange, snooze and caution indicators

info.$description: Info blue — matches Raycast theme blue, informational badges and links

purple.$description: Purple accent — Raycast Pro/AI features indicator, extension category color

border-subtle.$description: Barely visible divider — list item separators, panel edges inside glass

border-default.$description: Standard border — command palette outline, card edges, input fields

border-strong.$description: Prominent border — focused input outlines, active panel edges

selection.$description: Selection highlight — selected item in command list, text selection background

focus-ring.$description: Double-ring keyboard focus — dark gap + accent ring for WCAG visibility on dark

font-display.$description: Display/heading — Inter for marketing, SF Pro in native app. Both share geometric DNA.

font-body.$description: Body/UI — same stack, SF Pro Text optimized for smaller sizes in native app

font-mono.$description: Monospace — keyboard shortcut labels, code snippets, extension script output

scale-display.$description: Display — marketing hero headlines, onboarding splash (rare inside launcher)

scale-section.$description: Section — landing page section headings, store category titles

scale-title.$description: Title — extension detail heading, settings page headers

scale-base.$description: Base — search input text, command list primary label (macOS-native 15px)

scale-small.$description: Small — command descriptions, action bar labels, list metadata

scale-caption.$description: Caption — keyboard shortcut hints, status bar text, badge labels

line-height-tight.$description: Tight — display headings, single-line command labels

line-height-normal.$description: Normal — body text, command descriptions, readable content

line-height-relaxed.$description: Relaxed — marketing copy, extension readme content

weight-regular.$description: Regular — body text, command descriptions, metadata

weight-medium.$description: Medium — command names, nav items, button labels, action bar text

weight-semibold.$description: Semibold — section headings, selected command emphasis, keyboard shortcut keys

letter-spacing-tight.$description: Tight tracking — display and section headings

letter-spacing-normal.$description: Normal tracking — body text, slightly negative like macOS system UI

letter-spacing-wide.$description: Wide tracking — all-caps section labels, keyboard shortcut hint text

unit.$description: Base unit — Raycast uses 4px grid for compact launcher density

2xs.$description: Hairline — icon-to-shortcut-label gap, inline badge internal padding

xs.$description: Extra small — tight icon-text gaps, keyboard shortcut key spacing

sm.$description: Small — list item horizontal padding, action bar gaps, result item spacing

md.$description: Medium — search input padding, button padding, card internal padding

lg.$description: Large — command palette horizontal padding, section internal padding

xl.$description: Extra large — modal content padding, extension detail margins

2xl.$description: Double XL — marketing section padding, hero internal spacing

section-gap.$description: Section spacing — marketing page section separation

command-item-height.$description: Command list row height — optimized for keyboard navigation scan speed

search-bar-height.$description: Search input height — prominent, oversized for launcher's primary input

action-bar-height.$description: Action bar height — bottom bar with actions and keyboard shortcuts

launcher-width.$description: Default launcher width — the canonical Raycast command palette width

container-max.$description: Max container — marketing site content width

radius-sm.$description: Small — keyboard shortcut keys, inline badges, tags

radius-md.$description: Medium — list item hover, action bar buttons, small cards

radius-lg.$description: Large — buttons, input fields, extension cards

radius-xl.$description: Extra large — command palette container, modals, featured cards

radius-2xl.$description: Double XL — marketing hero containers, overlay panels

radius-pill.$description: Pill — tag badges, toggle switches, avatar containers

level-0.$description: Flat — list items at rest, action bar elements

level-1.$description: Subtle — raised panels, sidebar edge shadow

level-2.$description: Elevated — command palette window, modals, extension detail overlay

level-3.$description: Dramatic — launcher window itself floating on desktop, critical overlays

glow-accent.$description: Accent glow — subtle red glow on accent buttons, loading indicator halo

glass-blur.$description: Glass backdrop blur — standard frosted glass effect matching macOS vibrancy

glass-saturation.$description: Glass saturation boost — backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) for vibrancy effect

gradient-brand.$description: Brand gradient — the signature red-to-pink used on CTAs, loading bars, hero elements

gradient-brand-extended.$description: Extended gradient — orange-red-pink for hero backgrounds, marketing splash

gradient-surface.$description: Surface gradient — subtle top-lit effect on glass panels, command palette header

duration-instant.$description: Instant — keyboard selection highlight, shortcut feedback, list item focus

duration-fast.$description: Fast — hover states, focus rings, action bar transitions

duration-normal.$description: Normal — command palette open, panel slides, dropdown appear

duration-smooth.$description: Smooth — extension detail expand, modal enter/exit, page transitions

easing-snap.$description: Snap — fast-in no-bounce for keyboard-driven interactions, macOS-native feel

easing-smooth.$description: Smooth — natural deceleration for panels and overlays

easing-spring.$description: Spring — subtle overshoot for launcher appear, confetti moments

compact.$description: Compact — compact mode launcher, marketing mobile breakpoint

wide.$description: Wide — large desktop, expanded marketing hero
